simulation_methodology.model: Nagumo bistable reaction-diffusion cable: dV/dt = V(1-V)(V-a) + sum(g_link*(V_neighbor - V)), a=0.12
simulation_methodology.measurement: theta measured by machine linear regression of threshold-crossing time (V=0.5, linearly interpolated between timesteps) vs cell index, over a middle window excluding stimulus/boundary artifacts; R^2 reported for every fit; never read off a plot
simulation_methodology.ooda_correction_applied: First pass (cable_sim2.py) used t_max=400 and a narrow (4-6 cell) stimulus; several LOW-Gc cases showed 'propagation failure'. Rather than report this as a negative, it was FORCE-CHECKED (Observe/Orient/Decide/Act): re-ran the same low-Gc cases with an 8-16x longer time budget (up to 3000-8000 time units) and a wider stimulus. Part-A low-Gc cases (uniform cable) DID propagate once given enough time -- the original 'failure' was a harness artifact (fixed in cable_sim3.py's adaptive per-Gc time budget, sized off the exact analytic formula purely for PLANNING, not circularly used as the measured answer). Part-B's low-g_gap cases (two-resistor cable) did NOT propagate even at 16x budget with a wider stimulus (downstream cell peak V stayed at 0.007-0.04, far below the 0.5 threshold) -- confirmed as a genuine conduction-block/pinning phenomenon, externally corroborated by Muller-Borer et al 1995 (PMID 8720211) and Rohr 2004 (PMID 15094351).

partA_uniform_cable_vs_exact_analytic.formula: c_exact = (1-2a)*sqrt(Gc/2), a=0.12 -- classical closed-form Nagumo/Zeldovich-Frank-Kamenetskii bistable traveling-front speed

decorrelated_anchor: Three independent anchor classes, none a tautology: (1) an EXACT closed-form analytic front-speed formula (Nagumo/Zeldovich-Frank-Kamenetskii, external mathematics, not fitted); (2) real, live-verified, primary-literature measured conduction velocities and % reductions (Guerrero/Gutstein/Danik/Thomas, four independent mouse cohorts/preparations); (3) an independent human-expert review (Rohr 2004) stating the same two-regime qualitative pattern in its own words, written without knowledge of this session's simulation.
honest_gaps: Absolute ~0.5 m/s CV not derived from first-principles biophysical constants this session (cytoplasmic resistivity/C_m not independently re-verified); anchored instead to Guerrero's real measured WT value (0.32 m/s adult mouse), same order of magnitude, mouse-vs-larger-mammal difference disclosed not resolved.
%-Cx43-protein-remaining ~= %-conductance-remaining is a disclosed simplifying assumption, not independently verified.
Real cardiac g_myo/g_gap operating point not pinned this session -- 4 candidate baselines tested, robustness (not a single fitted number) is the reported result.
Gutstein's exact residual Cx43% for the full cardiac-restricted KO not stated in the verified abstract -- illustrative ~5%-remaining placeholder used, flagged as such.
Cx45 has no single clean homomeric unitary-conductance point-value pinned to one primary source this session (qualitative 'lowest of the cardiac connexins' + a heterotypic-with-Cx40 number only).

CMT1X's share of ALL CMT cases (broad epidemiology) not verified this session -- only its rank within specific verified cohorts (leading CMT2 gene; part of a 92%-of-confirmed-CMT 4-gene bloc in one 197-case Italian cohort). The commonly-quoted 'second most common CMT' framing is deliberately NOT asserted.
Single-species-class (mostly mouse) cardiac dose-response data; no independently-verified human ventricular strand/whole-heart Cx43-dose-response citation found this session.
Exact <1kDa metabolic-coupling cutoff bracketed (457 Da crosses, 10000 Da excluded) but not independently pinned to one primary source for the precise commonly-cited ~1kDa number.
Reduced (Nagumo/FHN) excitable-media model, not a full ionic cardiac model -- captures leading-edge/foot-of-AP geometry, not full AP morphology/repolarization/restitution.
Two citation drifts caught and corrected live this session (Guerrero PMID 9109443->9109444; Paznekas PMID 12629597->12457340) -- disclosed per this project's own convention, not swept under the rug.
Shibayama 2005 (PMID 15879313) and Vitiello 2005 (PMID 15637728) verified bibliographically only (title/author/journal), abstracts not fetched -- cited as secondary/corroborating only.

proposed_cell.hidden_state: gap-junction conductance (isoform, channel number, gating state) as the determinant of both electrical conduction velocity and metabolic small-molecule coupling range in a coupled-cell syncytium
legs: biophysical single-channel conductance measurements (patch-clamp, cross-isoform, this document section 6)
cable-theory/discrete-excitable-media simulation with an exact analytic cross-check (this document section 3)
real Cx43-dose-response knockdown/knockout data across 4 independent mouse preparations (this document sections 4-5)
3 decorrelated human disease phenotypes across 3 organs (GJB2/cochlea, GJB1/nerve, GJA1/craniofacial+cardiac; this document section 8)
proposed_cell.anchor: measured single-channel conductance (patch-clamp, multiple independent primary papers) + measured ventricular conduction velocity and its graded reduction under Cx43 loss (Guerrero/Gutstein/Danik/Thomas, independent of each other and of this document's own simulation) + an exact closed-form analytic front-speed formula (external mathematics)
proposed_cell.composition_mode: complementary-AND: electrical (conductance/CV) and metabolic (dye-transfer) legs must BOTH hold for the 'gap junction as a coupling channel' claim, and are shown to be correlated-but-dissociable, not collapsed into one number
proposed_cell.next_step_if_executed: acquire a human or large-mammal ventricular myocyte strand or whole-heart Cx43 graded-knockdown dataset (closing the single-species honest gap) and/or independently verify cardiac cytoplasmic resistivity + C_m primary sources to attempt the first-principles absolute-CV derivation this session explicitly did not attempt.
